name: 3 Resources for [Painpoint]
description: Hook states a painpoint to camera and pivots to the solution; three quick resource cards — white pill title/description overlays over screen recordings; follow CTA. Re-measured directly against the reference reel public/reels/cs-resources.mp4 (720x1280, 30fps): hook 2.933s, resources 1.633/1.667/1.900s, cta 1.467s — all hard cuts, no transitions.

musicSlot.name: music
musicSlot.label: Background music (optional)
musicSlot.instructions: Optional music bed that you own or that is licensed to you. For posting, prefer adding trending audio inside Instagram/TikTok — it is licensed there and the render never bakes it in.

slots.name: hook_clip
slots.label: Hook background clip
slots.example: A shot of a blank resume, or an empty job-search screen
slots.instructions: A vertical video clip that plays behind your hook text. It just needs to relate to the problem — you don't need to say anything on camera; the words on screen do the talking.

slots.name: hook_text
slots.label: Painpoint — big hook text
slots.instructions: The problem your viewer has, written in their own words, in quotes. Keep it to two short lines — this is the first thing they read.

slots.name: resolve_text
slots.label: Pivot word (flashes briefly)
slots.instructions: A short phrase that flashes on screen for a split second right before your first resource appears — like a punchline. Leave this blank to use "GO HERE".

slots.name: resource1_clip
slots.label: Resource 1 — screen recording
slots.example: A slow scroll through the resource's website or app, about 2 seconds
slots.instructions: A short screen recording of this resource — scroll its page slowly so it's clearly visible. 2 seconds is plenty.

slots.name: resource1_title
slots.label: Resource 1 — name
slots.instructions: The resource's name, short and numbered. Shown as a white card near the top of the screen.

slots.name: resource1_desc
slots.label: Resource 1 — why it helps
slots.example: Learn full-stack web dev for free, step by step
slots.instructions: One short sentence on why this fixes the painpoint. Fits about two lines. Shown as a second white card below the title.

slots.name: resource2_clip
slots.label: Resource 2 — screen recording
slots.example: A slow scroll through the resource's website or app, about 2 seconds
slots.instructions: A short screen recording of this resource — scroll its page slowly so it's clearly visible. 2 seconds is plenty.

slots.name: resource2_title
slots.label: Resource 2 — name
slots.instructions: The resource's name, short and numbered. Shown as a white card near the top of the screen.

slots.name: resource2_desc
slots.label: Resource 2 — why it helps
slots.instructions: One short sentence on why this fixes the painpoint. Fits about two lines. Shown as a second white card below the title.

slots.label: Resource 3 — screen recording
slots.example: A slow scroll through the resource's website or app, about 2 seconds
slots.instructions: A short screen recording of this resource — scroll its page slowly so it's clearly visible. 2 seconds is plenty.

slots.label: Resource 3 — name
slots.instructions: The resource's name, short and numbered. Shown as a white card near the top of the screen.

slots.name: resource3_desc
slots.label: Resource 3 — why it helps
slots.example: Build real projects instead of just watching tutorials
slots.instructions: One short sentence on why this fixes the painpoint. Fits about two lines. Shown as a second white card below the title.

slots.name: cta_clip
slots.label: Closing clip
slots.example: A quick clip of you pointing up or smiling at the camera
slots.instructions: A simple closing shot of you — pointing up or smiling both work well. 1.5 seconds is plenty.

slots.name: cta_text
slots.label: Follow prompt
slots.instructions: Tell viewers what to do next. One short phrase per line works best — up to about 4 lines.
